func use(items: [Int], operation: (Int) async -> Void, width: Int) async {
  let serial = 1
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 1, operation)
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, width: 1, operation: operation)
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, width: 1) { item in await operation(item) }
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, serial, operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 4, operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, width: 4, operation: operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, operation)
}
